title: Indian Market News Brief — 13 Nov 2026 — Nifty 50
quick_read: Strong foreign investment buying and upcoming state-owned company listings may support Indian markets. On the other hand, rising retail inflation, lower monthly mutual fund additions, and a weaker rupee could create pressure. Global weakness in technology stocks adds uncertainty.

stories.headline: October retail inflation surge may weigh on housing demand, raise rate hike concerns: Knight Frank, PHDCCI
stories.summary:
India's retail inflation rose to 6.09 per cent in October.
Industry bodies warned this could reduce household spending on items such as housing.
Higher inflation also increases expectations of interest rate hikes by the Reserve Bank of India.
Rising interest rates make loans more expensive for individuals and businesses.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Higher inflation and potential interest rate increases may slow company earnings growth and make loans costlier.

stories.headline: Foreign inflows lift Indian stocks' dollar returns above rupee gains as currency rebounds
stories.summary:
Foreign portfolio investors bought Indian shares worth 60,698 crore rupees in the first 11 days of November.
This is the highest monthly foreign buying since December 2023.
The strong inflows helped India become the fifth-largest stock market in the world.
Falling crude oil prices also helped boost market sentiment.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Large investments by foreign funds bring fresh money into Indian shares and support market growth.

stories.headline: Nvidia stock plunges 14% to over one-year low as Jensen Huang quits amid affair; market cap falls below $4 trillion
stories.summary:
Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang resigned from his post.
Nvidia shares plunged over 14 per cent following the announcement.
The drop wiped out 300 billion dollars in market value and affected other technology companies worldwide.
An interim chief executive officer has been appointed while a permanent successor is sought.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Sharp drops in global technology stocks could create caution among investors in Indian software companies.

stories.headline: UPI MDR rollout after Diwali: What it means for Paytm, MobiKwik and Pine Labs | What investors should know
stories.summary:
A new fee framework for UPI merchant payments above 2,000 rupees is expected to take effect.
Transactions above this amount will generally attract a 0.4 per cent fee.
This change aims to provide digital payment companies with a steady revenue stream.
Paytm recently reported a September quarter profit of 226 crore rupees.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Earning regular fee income on payments could improve profits for digital payment and financial technology firms.

stories.headline: India's Next Billion-Dollar IPO? Coal India subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields in line after Jio, NSE - key things to know
stories.summary:
Coal India subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields is preparing for an initial public offering to raise up to 1 billion dollars.
Market regulator SEBI gave its observation letter on November 4.
Coal India plans to sell a 10 per cent stake through an offer for sale.
The listing is expected in late November or early December.

stories.headline: Zee Entertainment approves Rs 600-crore share buyback at Rs 91 apiece; promoters to stay out
stories.summary:
Zee Entertainment approved a share buyback worth 600 crore rupees.
The buyback price is fixed at 91 rupees per share, a 24 per cent premium over its latest closing price.
The company set November 25 as the record date.
Company promoters will not participate in the buyback.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Share buybacks at a higher price return money to shareholders and show corporate confidence.

stories.headline: भारी उद्योग मंत्रालय को पीएलआईएसीसी योजना के अंतर्गत 10 गीगावॉट उन्नत रसायन सेल विनिर्माण क्षमता के लिए 22 निविदाएं प्राप्त हुई
stories.summary:
The Ministry of Heavy Industries received 22 tenders under its manufacturing scheme.
The bidding covers 10 gigawatt-hours of advanced chemistry cell battery manufacturing capacity.
This program comes under the government's Production Linked Incentive scheme.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Government incentives for battery manufacturing support long-term investment in auto parts and clean energy.

stories.headline: Page Industries shares plunge 13% as higher RM costs hit Q2 profitability; can festive demand drive a recovery?
stories.summary:
Page Industries reported a 4 per cent year-on-year increase in quarterly net profit to 202.5 crore rupees.
Revenue rose 11.5 per cent to 1,439.6 crore rupees.
Higher raw material costs weighed on profit margins, causing the stock to fall sharply.
The company declared a dividend of 150 rupees per share.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: Large dividend payouts benefit investors, but higher raw material costs remain a concern for manufacturing profits.

stories.headline: Oct SIP openings at 18-month low, closures highest since April 2025
stories.summary:
New monthly Systematic Investment Plan account openings fell to an 18-month low in October.
Total active SIP accounts dropped from 108.9 million to 108 million.
Account closures reached their highest level since April 2025.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Slower domestic investment flows mean less regular retail money entering Indian stock funds.

stories.headline: Rupee falls 33 paise to close at 94.04 against US dollar
stories.summary:
The Indian rupee fell 35 paise to close at 94.04 against the US dollar.
During the day, the currency moved between a high of 93.62 and a low of 94.06.
Higher oil prices and inflation worries put pressure on the Indian currency.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: A weaker currency makes imported items like raw oil more expensive for local companies.
